fusions.name: Bearing Down
fusions.desc: You charge up to 8 tiles to the target and sting it, dealing 18 damage, making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. For 5 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Stampede Fan
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone of stingers ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you run since you last used it (max +25%).

fusions.name: Rallying Gallop
fusions.desc: Restores 10 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Using it increases your movement speed by 25% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Pace
fusions.desc: As you move, your damage rises 25% for 5 seconds, and stingers fight beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
